name: The smithy
summary: A small rented smithy on the Truro road at the edge of Redruth.

performance.workspace: one room; room for a hearth, an anvil, a bench and a small job

flaws: No water power: any machine must be driven by hand, horse or something you build
Dark inside; fine work needs the doorway light
notes: Rent £1 10s a quarter, paid to Midsummer.
